title: Respite and Short-Term Stay Agreement Terms: Who May Book a Stay
content:
**Clause 1 — Number of stays.** A customer may hold any number of stays under the Respite and Short-Term Stay Agreement over time; no limit is set on how many stays one customer may have in total. Only one stay may be open at a time: a new stay may be booked only when the customer has no other stay in booked or in-stay status.

**Clause 2 — Current care residents.** A short stay is for people who do not already live in Larkspur assisted living or memory care: no stay may be booked while the customer has an assisted living or memory care residency (an Assisted Living Residency and Care Agreement or a Memory Care Residency Agreement) in pending admission, active, on leave or notice given status.

**Clause 3 — Independent living residents.** A Larkspur independent living resident may book an Assisted Living Respite Stay (Standard, Enhanced or Extensive Care) or a Post-Hospital Recovery Stay, but not an Independent Living Trial Stay, and the independent living monthly fees continue unchanged during the stay.

## Basis of the checks

Both booking conditions are read from the company's records before the booking, matched to the customer being booked: Clause 1 from the statuses of that customer's existing short stays, Clause 2 from the statuses of that customer's assisted living or memory care residencies. A stay already completed, cancelled or converted is not open and does not stand in the way of a new booking.

## Booking check table

| Customer's existing short stay | Customer's assisted living or memory care residency | New stay may be booked |
|---|---|---|
| None, or only completed, cancelled or converted stays | None in pending admission, active, on leave or notice given status | Yes, subject to the other terms of the stay type |
| A stay in booked status | Any | No |
| A stay in in-stay status | Any | No |
| Any | One in pending admission, active, on leave or notice given status | No |

## Stay types open to an independent living resident

| Stay type | Position for a Larkspur independent living resident under Clause 3 |
|---|---|
| Independent Living Trial Stay | May not be booked |
| Assisted Living Respite Stay (Standard Care) | May be booked |
| Assisted Living Respite Stay (Enhanced Care) | May be booked |
| Assisted Living Respite Stay (Extensive Care) | May be booked |
| Post-Hospital Recovery Stay | May be booked |
| Memory Care Respite Stay | Clause 3 sets no rule |

During such a stay the resident's independent living monthly fees continue unchanged.
